description: Change the ownership of folders and optionally dashboards.

executing_user.description: The user running the operation. This is necessary for API access checks.

folder_name.description: The target folder whose ownership needs to be changed.

new_owner_name.description: The new owner to whom the folder (and optionally dashboards) ownership will be transferred.

original_owner_rule.description: The ownership rule to set for the original owner after changing ownership (``"edit"`` or ``"view"``). Default is ``"edit"``.

change_dashboard_ownership.description: Whether to also change the ownership of dashboards in the folder tree. Default is ``True``.

examples.user_query: Transfer ownership of the 'Sales Reports' folder to jane.doe@example.com, running as admin@example.com, and transfer the dashboards inside it too — the previous owner should keep edit access.
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Sales Reports' folder and all dashboards within it to Jane Doe. The original owner retains 'edit' permissions.

examples.user_query: I need to change the owner of the 'Marketing Data' folder to John Smith but leave the dashboards ownership unchanged.
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Marketing Data' folder to John Smith, sets the original owner's permissions to 'view', and leaves dashboard ownership unchanged.

examples.user_query: Can I reassign the 'Finance Team' folder to a new owner while keeping the original owner as an editor?
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Finance Team' folder and its dashboards to Alice Jones. The original owner retains 'edit' permissions.
